
   chainlock

  Extend  Make a lock take longer to open

  ┃ Lock
  ┃ A .lock file (with its .payload next to it), or a .chainlock.tar.
  ┃ >

    Add
    How much longer opening it should take, such as 2h or 1w.
    Or an exact number of steps.
    > 12h

    Save as
    Optional. Where to write the longer lock.
    > update the lock in place

    Workers
    Steps computed at once. 0 or -1: one per core (4 here).
    > 0

  tab complete · enter next · esc menu
